meta.notes: Nightly room rates are LIVE/DYNAMIC and cannot be statically verified. Use the official booking link for an exact 7-night total. Comparison formula: (nightly room rate + resort fee) x 7, then + ~13.38% lodging tax (Clark County Strip). Resort fee shown is the published nightly fee before tax. All hotels listed offer private bathroom + queen-size bed or larger (king, 2 queens, or suites) — confirm exact room type at booking. Michelin counts use RTC bus/Monorail/walk methodology; bus times are estimates to confirm in the RTC trip planner (rtcsnv.com). Las Vegas has no subway.

hotels.name: The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas
hotels.michelin_on_site: é by José Andrés (1★) + China Poblano (Bib Gourmand)
hotels.why: Highest Michelin density: 1 starred + 1 Bib on-site, ARIA/Gymkhana next door, Bellagio/Michael Mina 10-min walk. Best base for a Michelin-first trip.
hotels.amenities: Casino, 3 pools, spa, Boulevard Tower suites with terraces
hotels.flag: Resort fee + nightly rate must be confirmed live; fee range is indicative only.

hotels.name: MGM Grand Las Vegas
hotels.room_example: MGM King / Two Queen, 446 sq ft (private bath, queen+)
hotels.michelin_on_site: Joël Robuchon (2★) + L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon (1★)
hotels.why: Only hotel with TWO starred restaurants on-site (incl. the city's only 2★). Chinatown/Downtown are 45–60 min by bus — the tradeoff.
hotels.amenities: Largest pool complex on Strip (6.5 acres, lazy river), Monorail station, T-Mobile Arena next door
hotels.flag: Nightly rate dynamic; $50 resort fee verified Oct 2026 — re-check at booking.

hotels.name: Bellagio Hotel & Casino
hotels.why: Central location + Fountains + Conservatory on-site; walk to Cosmo/ARIA/Caesars cluster. Michael Mina Selected in-house.
hotels.amenities: Fountains of Bellagio (free), Conservatory & Botanical Gardens, pool, spa
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: Caesars Palace Las Vegas
hotels.why: Guy Savoy 1★ on-site; Forum Shops + Colosseum on-site; 10-min walk to Venetian cluster (4 Selected).
hotels.amenities: Forum Shops, Garden of the Gods pool, Colosseum theater, spa
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: ARIA Resort & Casino
hotels.why: CityCenter hub: Gymkhana on-site, Cosmo/Bellagio/Crystals walkable. Smart-room tech, tram to Park MGM/Crystals.
hotels.amenities: Pool deck, spa, Crystals shopping, tram access
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
hotels.room_example: Suite King / 2 Queens, 650+ sq ft (private bath, queen+)
hotels.why: Highest Selected count on-site (3) + Mott 32 at Palazzo next door. All-suite property = extra space for couples.
hotels.amenities: All-suite rooms, Grand Canal Shoppes, gondola rides, Canyon Ranch spa
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: Wynn Las Vegas
hotels.why: Wing Lei Selected on-site; luxury service benchmark; walk to Venetian cluster. Premium price tier.
hotels.amenities: Lake of Dreams, spa, golf, Encore tower
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: Fontainebleau Las Vegas
hotels.why: Newest luxury resort; 15–20 min to Venetian/Wynn cluster by walk/bus. No Michelin on-site — pick for newness, not dining density.
hotels.amenities: Multiple pools, spa, nightlife, large rooms
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: Park MGM Las Vegas
hotels.why: Smoke-free resort, shortest walk to T-Mobile Arena; walk to Cosmo/ARIA/Bellagio cluster. Value pick among luxury-tier resorts.
hotels.amenities: Smoke-free casino, Eataly, Park outdoor district, pools
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.

hotels.name: Circa Resort & Casino (Downtown)
hotels.why: Downtown base: Fremont Street + Soulbelly BBQ + Esther's Kitchen nearby; Strip cluster 35–50 min by Deuce bus. Best if Downtown nightlife is the priority.
hotels.amenities: Stadium Swim pool complex, Fremont Street access, sportsbook
hotels.flag: Nightly rate + resort fee must be confirmed live.
